caseNameFull: Ramdass v. Angelone, Director, Virginia Department of Corrections

opinions.text: C. A. 4th Cir. Application for stay of execution of sentence of death, presented to The Chief Justice, and by him referred to the Court, granted pending disposition of the petition for writ of certiorari. Should the petition for writ of certiorari be denied, this stay shall terminate automically. In the event the petition for writ of certiorari is granted, the stay shall continue pending the sending down of the judgment of this Court.
